title: Tax the rich: from slogan to reality
by: Tax Justice Network for the Greens/EFA Group in the European Parliament
summary: Study of a moderate progressive wealth tax on the top 0.5% of EU households (1.7-3.5%) and of ending offshore tax abuse; the Maltese figures are about 43 million euro a year from the wealth tax (0.25% of GDP) and 301 million from tax abuse, as reported by Newsbook on 2023-09-21.

title: The applicability of a wealth tax in Malta: an analysis
by: J. Mangion (University of Malta master's dissertation)
summary: Interview-based study (15 tax professionals and stakeholders) that proposes a Maltese wealth tax for revenue and to cut wealth inequality, while advising the government to weigh alternatives that keep Malta's low-tax position.
